sourceEvidence.title: Air Dominance Technical Lead
sourceEvidence.quote:
- Manage a cross functional team of 7-10 Responsible Engineering Authorities (REAs) including mechanical and electrical engineers.

- Analyze data related to factory throughput and yield and make recommendations for their improvement.

- Interface with program and factory chief engineers to ensure engineering alignment with constraints, improvements, and routine changes.

- Partner with Value Stream Managers (VSM) and Value Stream Leads (VSL) to ensure factory has the program support needed to maintain desired production throughput and yield rates.

- Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SME), Product Test Engineers (PTE), and Manufacturing Engineers (ME) to ensure they are working in lockstep with your REA team members.

- Communicate with suppliers and travel when necessary to support critical constraints and important reviews.

- Maintain material and labor budgets for the Integrated Product Team (IPT) and report deviations weekly in front of peers and Program Manager (PM).

- Maintain a project tracking system, holding REAs accountable for their projects and reviewing list a minimum of once per week with each REA.

- Innovate to create improvement projects improving throughput and yield across multiple factories including Andover CCA factory and Tucson RF/EI factory.
